name: Brain knowledge UI/search remains read-only until usefulness proof
decision: Brain knowledge UI/search should render read-only BrainKnowledgeReadModel cards with proof boundaries before any API, MCP, dashboard, DB search service, or mutation-capable surface is built.
falsifier: A future brain knowledge UI/search slice mutates Memory Core, SourceDecision, candidate status, or evidence, or adds API/MCP/dashboard before static preview usefulness fails or becomes insufficient.
doesNotProve: This card does not prove browser UX polish, search ranking quality, catalog completeness, product readiness, or that API/MCP/dashboard will never be needed.
